title_en: Lutski Prayer for a Time of Plague

content.english: O Adonai, God of gods and Lord of lords,
Who rules over the high heavens, and has dominion down below,

content.hebrew: Hannoten layya‘ef kowaḥ ve‘otsma le’en onim
content.transliteration: הַנֹּתֵן לַיָּעֵף כֹּחַ וְעָצְמָה לְאֵין אֹנִים,
content.english: Who gives strength to the weary, and might to the powerless,

content.hebrew: Zechor lanu hayyom uvchol yom vayom berit avotenu haḳḳadmonim
content.transliteration: זְכוֹר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל יוֹם וָיוֹם בְּרִית אֲבֹתֵינוּ הַקַּדְמֹנִים,
content.english: Remember for us, today and every day, the covenant of our ancient ancestors,

content.transliteration: וּבְרִית שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה מִדּוֹת רַחֲמִים וְתַחֲנוּנִים,
content.english: And the covenant of the thirteen attributes of mercy and of supplication,

content.transliteration: הַכְּתוּבִים בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ עַל יְדֵי צִיר אֱמוּנִים.
content.english: Which are written in your Torah, by [Moses] the faithful messenger.

Adonai, Adonai, God, merciful and gracious, long-suffering, and abundant in goodness and truth; keeping mercy unto the thousandth generation, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin; and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and unto the fourth generation. (Exodus 33:6–7)
Faithful God,
Merciful father,
Who heals all the sicknesses of his servants,
And bandages the pains of those he loves,
Who redeems from the grave the life of his pious people,
And rescues from death the life of his impoverished people.
Master of worlds,
Father of mercy,
Behold, we are your servants,
Children of your three beloved [patriarchs].
We come in prayer and supplication to you,

content.hebrew: Levaḳḳesh raḥamim vaḥanina millifnē chissē chevodecha
content.transliteration: לְבַקֵּשׁ רַחֲמִים וַחֲנִינָה מִלִּפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶךָ,
content.english: To beg for mercy and kindness in front of the throne of your Glory –
That your mercy should prevail over your other qualities,

content.hebrew: Vetitnaheḡ ‘immanu bemiddat haḥesed veharaḥamim kefi ḥoḳ elahutecha
content.transliteration: וְתִתְנַהֵג עִמָּנוּ בְּמִדַּת הַחֶסֶד וְהָרַחֲמִים כְּפִי חֹק אֱלָהוּתֶךָ,
content.english: And that you behave toward us using the quality of kindness and mercy, in accordance with the regular practice of your godliness.

content.hebrew: Vehaser me‘alenu middat haddin hametuḥa ‘alenu ba‘avonotenu
content.transliteration: וְהָסֵר מֵעָלֵינוּ מִדַּת הַדִּין הַמְתוּחָה עָלֵינוּ בַּעֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ, וְתַעְצֹר הַדֶּבֶר וְהַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעָלֵינוּ וּמֵעַל בָּתֵּינוּ.
content.english: And remove from us the quality of stern judgment, which is stretched out over us, due to our sins,

content.hebrew: Veta‘tsor haddever vehammaggefa me‘alenu ume‘al battenu.
content.english: And stop the pestilence and plague from us and from our households!
O king who reigns over kings, show us kindness and mercy,
Just as you showed mercy to our ancestors

content.hebrew: Bizman moshē rabbenu ‘alav hash-shalom ka’asher yatsa haḳḳetsef millefanecha
content.transliteration: בִּזְמַן מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם כַּאֲשֶׁר יָצָא הַקֶּצֶף מִלְּפָנֶיךָ
content.english: At the time of Moses our Teacher, peace be upon him, when rage issued from you,

content.hebrew: Vetsivvita le’aharon hakkohen lehaḳtir ḳetoret ulchapper ba‘adam
content.transliteration: וְצִוִּיתָ לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן לְהַקְטִיר קְטֹרֶת וּלְכַפֵּר בַּעֲדָם
content.english: And you commanded Aaron the Priest to burn incense and atone for them,
As written in your Torah:

content.hebrew: Vayyomer moshē el aharon ḳaḥ et hammaḥta veten ‘aleha esh me‘al hammizbeyaḥ vesim ḳetoret veholech mehera el ha‘eda vechapper ‘alehem, ki yatsa haḳḳetsef millifnē adonai heḥel hannaḡef. Vayyiḳḳaḥ aharon ka’asher dibber moshē vayyarots el toch haḳḳahal vehinnē heḥel hanneḡef ba‘am, vayyitten et haḳḳetoret vaichapper ‘al ha‘am.Vayya‘amod ben hammetim uven haḥayyim, vatte‘atsar hammaggefa.
content.transliteration: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֣ח אֶת־הַ֠מַּחְתָּה וְתֶן־עָלֶ֨יהָ אֵ֜שׁ מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ וְשִׂ֣ים קְטֹ֔רֶת וְהוֹלֵ֧ךְ מְהֵרָ֛ה אֶל־הָֽעֵדָ֖ה וְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־יָצָ֥א הַקֶּ֛צֶף מִלִּפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה הֵחֵ֥ל הַנָּֽגֶף׃ וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַֽהֲרֹ֜ן כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֣ר ׀ דִּבֶּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיָּ֨רָץ֙ אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ הַקָּהָ֔ל וְהִנֵּ֛ה הֵחֵ֥ל הַנֶּ֖גֶף בָּעָ֑ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶֽת־הַקְּטֹ֔רֶת וַיְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־הָעָֽם׃ וַיַּֽעֲמֹ֥ד בֵּֽין־הַמֵּתִ֖ים וּבֵ֣ין הַֽחַיִּ֑ים וַתֵּֽעָצַ֖ר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃ (במדבר טז:יא-יג)
content.english: And Moses said unto Aaron: “Take your fire-pan, and put fire in it from the altar, and lay incense on it, and carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone forth from Adonai: the plague has begun.” And Aaron took as Moses spoke, and he ran into the midst of the assembly; and, behold, the plague had begun among the people; and he put on the incense, and made atonement for the people. And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed. (Numbers 16:11-13)

content.hebrew: Melech malchē hammelachim tikkon tefillatenu ḳetoret lefanecha,
content.transliteration: מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים תִּכּוֹן תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ קְטֹרֶת לְפָנֶיךָ, וְהָשֵׁךְ מִמֶּנּוּ קִצְפְּךָ וַחֲרוֹנֶךָ.
content.english: O king who reigns over kings, let our prayer be set forth before you as incense,

content.transliteration: שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ וְהִנָּחֵם עַל הָרָעָה לְעַמֶּךָ.
content.english: And calm down your anger and rage, away from us.

content.hebrew: Shuv meḥaron appecha vehinnaḥem ‘al hara‘a le‘ammecha.
content.english: Turn from your fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against your people.

content.transliteration: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם.
content.english: Turn for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.

content.hebrew: Hashivenu adonai elecha venashuva, ḥaddesh yamenu keḳedem.
content.english: Turn us unto your, O Adonai, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

content.transliteration: מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים חוּסָה וַחֲמוֹל עָלֵינוּ,
content.english: O king who reigns over kings, have pity and compassion for us,
Just as you had pity and compassion for our ancestors

content.hebrew: Bizman david hammelech ‘alav hash-shalom keshehaya haddever bahem veniḥamta ‘al hara‘a
content.transliteration: בִּזְמַן דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם כְּשֶׁהָיָה הַדֶּבֶר בָּהֶם וְנִחַמְתָּ עַל הָרָעָה
content.english: At the time of King David, peace be upon him, when they were suffering pestilence;
You were sorry for the evil,

content.hebrew: Vayyishlaḥ ha’elohim mal’ach lirushalayim lehash’ḥitah, uch’hash’ḥit ra’a adonai vayyinnaḥem ‘al hara‘a vayyomer lammal’ach hammash’ḥit, rav, ‘atta heref yadecha, umal’ach adonai ‘omed ‘im goren ornan haivusi. Vayyiven sham david mizbeyaḥ vayya‘al ‘olot ushlamim, vayyiḳra el adonai vayya‘anehu va’esh min hash-shamayim ‘al mizbaḥ ha‘ola. Vayyomer adonai lammal’ach vayyashev ḥarbo el nedanah.
content.transliteration: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֨ים ׀ מַלְאָ֥ךְ ׀ לִֽירוּשָׁלִַם֮ לְהַשְׁחִיתָהּ֒ וּכְהַשְׁחִ֗ית רָאָ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם עַל־הָֽרָעָ֔ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לַמַּלְאָ֤ךְ הַמַּשְׁחִית֙ רַ֔ב עַתָּ֖ה הֶ֣רֶף יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהֹוָה֙ עֹמֵ֔ד עִם־גֹּ֖רֶן אָרְנָ֥ן הַיְבוּסִֽי׃ (דברי הימים א כא:טו) וַיִּבֶן֩ שָׁ֨ם דָּוִ֤יד מִזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַל עֹל֖וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָא֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֤הוּ בָאֵשׁ֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֥ח הָֽעֹלָֽה׃ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ לַמַּלְאָ֔ךְ וַיָּ֥שֶׁב חַרְבּ֖וֹ אֶל־נְדָנָֽהּ׃ (דברי הימים א כא:כו-כז)
content.english: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it; and as he was about to destroy, Adonai beheld, and he was sorry for the evil, and said to the destroying angel: ‘It is enough; now stay your hand.’ And Adonai’s angel was standing by the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite. (I Chronicles 21:15) And David built there an altar unto Adonai, and offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings, and called upon Adonai; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt-offering. And Adonai commanded the angel; and he put up his sword back into the sheath thereof. (I Chronicles 21:25-26)

content.hebrew: Melech malche hammelachim tippol na lefanecha teḥinnatenu,
content.transliteration: מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים תִּפֹּל נָא לְפָנֶיךָ תְּחִנָּתֵנוּ,
content.english: O king who reigns over kings, may our supplication reach your presence.
Do not send us back from our petition in shame and embarrassment.

content.hebrew: Ulma‘an shimcha haggadol vehaḳḳadosh retsenu veḥonnenu va‘anenu,
content.transliteration: וּלְמַעַן שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ רְצֵנוּ וְחָנֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ,
content.english: For the sake of your great, holy name, show us favor, show us kindness, and answer us,
Since our eyes are lifted up to you.
Redeem us, O Adonai our God, from our trouble,
And stop the pestilence, the plague, and the destruction, from us and from our houses.

content.hebrew: Veta‘tsor haddever vehammaggefa vehammashḥit me‘alenu ume‘al battenu,
content.transliteration: וְתַעְצֹר הַדֶּבֶר וְהַמַּגֵּפָה וְהַמַּשְׁחִית מֵעָלֵינוּ וּמֵעַל בָּתֵּינוּ,
content.english: Show us kindness, Adonai, show us kindness!
Answer us, Adonai, answer us!
Heal us, O Adonai, and we shall be healed; rescue us, and we shall be rescue; for you are our praise.

content.hebrew: Melech malchē hammelachim ḳayyem ‘alenu miḳra’ot hakketuvot betoratecha.
content.transliteration: מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים קַיֵּם עָלֵינוּ מִקְרָאוֹת הַכְּתוּבוֹת בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ.
content.english: O king who reigns over kings, fulfill for us the verses written in your Torah:

content.hebrew: Vayyomer im shamowa‘ tishma‘ leḳol adonai elohecha vehayyashar be‘enav ta‘asē veha’azanta lemitsvotav veshamarta kol ḥuḳḳav, kol hammaḥala asher samti vemitsrayim lo asim ‘alecha ki ani adonai rofe’echa.
content.transliteration: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אִם־שָׁמ֨וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַ֜ע לְק֣וֹל ׀ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ וְהַיָּשָׁ֤ר בְּעֵינָיו֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְהַֽאֲזַנְתָּ֙ לְמִצְוֺתָ֔יו וְשָֽׁמַרְתָּ֖ כָּל־חֻקָּ֑יו כָּֽל־הַמַּחֲלָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֤מְתִּי בְמִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לֹֽא־אָשִׂ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה רֹֽפְאֶֽךָ׃ (שמות טו:כו)
content.english: And he said: “If you will diligently hearken to the voice of Adonai your God, and you will do that which is right in his eyes, and you will give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases upon you, which I have put upon the Egyptians; for I am Adonai who heals you.” (Exodus 15:26)

content.hebrew: Vehesir adonai mimmecha kol ḥoli, vechol madvē mitsrayim hara‘im asher yada‘ta lo yesimam bach untanam bechol sone’echa.
content.transliteration: וְהֵסִ֧יר יְהֹוָ֛ה מִמְּךָ֖ כָּל־חֹ֑לִי וְכָל־מַדְוֵי֩ מִצְרַ֨יִם הָֽרָעִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדַ֗עְתָּ לֹ֤א יְשִׂימָם֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּנְתָנָ֖ם בְּכָל־שֹֽׂנְאֶֽיךָ׃ (דברים ז:טו)
content.english: And Adonai will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, upon you, but will lay them upon all them that hate you. (Deuteronomy 7:15)

content.hebrew: El na refa na lanu. El na refa na lanu. El na refa na lanu.
content.transliteration: אֵל נָא רְפָא נָא לָנוּ. אֵל נָא רְפָא נָא לָנוּ. אֵל נָא רְפָא נָא לָנוּ.
content.english: Please, God, heal us, please! Please, God, heal us, please! Please, God, heal us, please!
Blessed be Adonai forever. Amen and Amen.
